name: Stored maintenance evidence reader
packageArguments: String values encoded as base64 JSON: {"Package":"Storage","ReportId":"existing-report-identifier","Section":"Index","Ordinal":"0","Page":"0"}. Package Storage or Update. Storage ReportId is the exact timestamp-guid filename without .json; Update ReportId is the 32-character lowercase run-directory GUID. No arbitrary paths or latest-file selection. Sections: Index (property names and profile count), Profiles (one zero-based profile Ordinal), ProfileIndex (count plus ordinal/decision/eligible rows without identifiers), ActionSummary (exact action counts grouped by storage Kind/Status or update phase/outcome, including result.outcome), Snapshot (before/after), Policy (update before.policy), Scan, Actions, Errors, Guards, Evidence, Omissions. Other sections require Ordinal 0. Page is zero-based; each response contains up to 2048 bytes of base64-encoded UTF8 JSON plus SectionBytes, SectionSha256, PageCount, ReportBytes and ReportSha256. Concatenate decoded bytes in page order, verify section SHA256, then decode UTF8 and parse JSON. Verify all response report hashes match before combining pages; reports can change while maintenance runs. Existing reports only, at most 16 MiB before parsing; output at most 7500 UTF8 bytes. Trust checks refuse reparse ancestors and untrusted owned-path ACLs. A locked read handle refuses concurrent writers; no report, ACL or directory modifications. No diagnostics, repairs, scans, deletions, reboot, network or Ninja calls. Existing pinned runner stages toolkit/branding as usual; evidence transport itself opens no maintenance notification because it only reads an already collected report. Invalid requests exit 1 with a generic bounded error. ActionSummary reports known nonnegative integral LogicalBytesReported sums and coverage counts; these include withheld actions and are NOT reclaimed space. Missing/unrecognized action shape or group labels set PartialCounts; missing/invalid logical sizes set PartialLogicalBytes. Action ErrorCount and ReportErrorCount remain separate because sources may overlap. At most five combined error samples include bounded category/message (64/160 characters), with paths, URLs and sensitive text omitted. Full Actions/Profiles transport remains available. Both projections use the same stable hashed 2048-byte paging and zero Ordinal.
